summary: Install-time exfiltration of AI provider API keys and host identity to hardcoded ngrok endpoint
details: Package easyway2@1.0.2 wires every npm lifecycle hook (preinstall, install, postinstall, prepare, prepublishOnly, postpack) to an inline node one-liner that enumerates process.env, matches values against OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/HuggingFace/Azure API-key regexes and key names (OPENAI, ANTHROPIC, GOOGLE_API, GEMINI, HF_TOKEN, HUGGINGFACE, AZURE_OPENAI_API), collects os.platform(), os.hostname(), and the OS username, and POSTs the collected data over HTTPS to crabbing-thong-overhung.ngrok-free.dev at /?Ai=1. The exfiltration fires automatically on npm install with no user opt-in, and the destination is a hardcoded attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel unrelated to any documented package purpose.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
